io.github.vivienm.ChatGPT.finish-args-only-wayland: This personal fork intentionally requires native Wayland and does not support X11-only sessions. The launcher selects ozone-platform=wayland; CI checks that the installed package grants neither X11 sockets nor host IPC sharing.
io.github.vivienm.ChatGPT.appid-url-not-reachable: This independently hosted Flatpak uses ChatGPT as its application name. Its packaging repository is https://github.com/vivienm/chatgpt-flatpak, not the inferred https://github.com/vivienm/chatgpt; the real repository is declared in AppStream metadata.
io.github.vivienm.ChatGPT.finish-args-own-name-org.freedesktop.Sta: Chromium registers its tray item under this exact name (sandbox pid is always 2). Without owning it the DBus proxy rejects the registration and the tray icon never appears.
